name: Egyptian Monumental
description: Massive stone architecture characterized by geometric precision, symbolic proportions, and enduring monumentality
key_features: ["colossal scale","post-and-lintel construction","precise geometric alignment","symbolic proportions","hieroglyphic decoration"]
notable_examples: ["Great Pyramid of Giza","Temple of Karnak","Abu Simbel","Luxor Temple"]

name: Greek Classical
description: Architecture emphasizing mathematical proportions, column orders, and harmonious spatial design
notable_examples: ["Parthenon","Temple of Hephaestus","Erechtheion","Temple of Zeus at Olympia"]

name: Roman Imperial
description: Engineering-driven architecture featuring arches, concrete construction, and monumental public buildings

name: Byzantine
description: Religious architecture featuring massive domes, rich mosaic decoration, and centralized plans
notable_examples: ["Hagia Sophia","Church of the Holy Apostles","San Vitale Ravenna","Chora Church"]

name: Romanesque
description: European style featuring rounded arches, thick walls, and fortress-like solidity

name: Gothic
description: Soaring architecture defined by pointed arches, ribbed vaults, flying buttresses, and luminous stained glass

name: Islamic
description: Architecture featuring geometric decoration, muqarnas vaulting, courtyards, and calligraphic ornamentation
notable_examples: ["Alhambra","Great Mosque of Cordoba","Dome of the Rock","Sheikh Lotfollah Mosque"]

name: Indian Temple
description: Monumental religious architecture with elaborately carved stone temples and towering superstructures

name: Chinese Traditional
description: Timber-frame architecture emphasizing harmony with nature, axial symmetry, and elaborate rooflines
key_features: ["timber frame construction","bracket sets (dougong)","curved rooflines","axial symmetry","feng shui orientation"]
notable_examples: ["Forbidden City","Temple of Heaven","Hanging Monastery","Hall of Supreme Harmony"]

name: Japanese Traditional
description: Architecture emphasizing natural materials, spatial simplicity, and integration with nature
key_features: ["post-and-beam timber","tatami module","sliding screens (shoji)","engawa veranda","natural material palette"]

name: Mesoamerican
description: Monumental stone pyramid-temples with elaborate sculptural programs and astronomical alignments

name: Renaissance
description: Revival of Classical forms emphasizing symmetry, proportion, and mathematical harmony
key_features: ["classical orders revival","symmetrical facades","dome construction","mathematical proportion","rusticated masonry"]
notable_examples: ["Florence Cathedral dome","St. Peter's Basilica","Palazzo Rucellai","Villa Rotonda"]

name: Baroque
description: Dramatic, theatrical architecture featuring curved forms, elaborate decoration, and spatial grandeur
notable_examples: ["St. Peter's Square","Palace of Versailles","Karlskirche Vienna","Church of the Gesu"]

name: Mughal
description: Synthesis of Islamic, Persian, and Indian architectural traditions with emphasis on symmetry and gardens
key_features: ["onion domes","pietra dura inlay","char bagh gardens","red sandstone and white marble","jali screens"]

name: Art Nouveau
description: Organic, nature-inspired architecture with sinuous curves and innovative use of iron and glass
key_features: ["organic curves","iron and glass","nature motifs","asymmetric facades","whiplash lines"]

name: Art Deco
description: Geometric, streamlined architecture combining modernism with lavish ornamentation
notable_examples: ["Chrysler Building","Empire State Building","Hoover Building","Eastern Columbia Building"]

name: Modernist
description: Architecture emphasizing function, minimal ornament, and new materials like steel, concrete, and glass
key_features: ["form follows function","open floor plans","curtain walls","pilotis","flat roofs"]

name: Khmer
description: Monumental temple-mountain architecture symbolizing Mount Meru with elaborate bas-relief narratives

name: Sub-Saharan African
description: Diverse building traditions using earth, thatch, and timber with sophisticated environmental adaptation
notable_examples: ["Great Mosque of Djenne","Great Zimbabwe","Lalibela rock churches","Timbuktu mosques"]

name: Andean
description: Masterful stone architecture featuring precise ashlar masonry without mortar and earthquake-resistant design
key_features: ["dry-stone ashlar masonry","trapezoidal openings","earthquake-resistant walls","terraced agriculture","integration with landscape"]
